info.description: Incremental contract for implemented Phase 4 reads only. Existing Phase 2/3 endpoints retain their contracts. Secure mode (AUTH_ENABLED=1) is required for beta identity. Later journey endpoints are not advertised as callable until implemented.

get.description: Actor comes from authentication. Calendar time and face checks remain simulations. GET is read-only. Payment prerequisites are reported, never granted. Cookie mutations require a matching Origin. Face simulation requires BETA_DATE_SIMULATION_ENABLED=1 and an approved account. Identical confirmation/step retries do not duplicate writes; changed signatures or slots conflict. Availability and alignment freeze after plan creation; selections freeze once either party signs.

409.description: Date closed/resolved, early or late feedback, missing flags, conflicting retry, started cancellation or historical resolution requiring review.

get.description: Date-scoped operation. GET has no transitions. Feedback opens one hour after the stored date (rounded up to the simulator hour) and closes on the next simulation week. Only own private feedback is returned. Exact recorded retries are safe; changed/stale submissions conflict. No-show is an unverified report and releases the pair without a punitive strike. Cancellation may assess a pending fee but never collects money. Timeout reconciliation is explicit and idempotent.
